description: This file is a shell script used for downloading and installing software images via TFTP or HTTP protocols, verifying checksum, managing storage partitions, and performing system reboots for firmware upgrades on an embedded device.

methods.name: tftpDownload
methods.description: Handles downloading files via TFTP, including checksum verification and cleanup.

methods.name: httpDownload
methods.description: Handles downloading files via HTTP, including checksum verification and cleanup.
